The op_node_* parameters choose the operation for each intermediate node. Node 0 is the input and node 6 is the output. IMPORTANT CONSTRAINTS: (1) The total number of edges set to 1 must be AT MOST 9. Architectures with more than 9 edges are INVALID and will always score 0. With 7 nodes (0-6), the upper triangular matrix has nodes 0-5 as rows, and edges go from lower to higher numbered nodes.
